name: PAN: Physics of Atomic Nuclei (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend a week at a world-leading nuclear physics lab. You explore nuclear astrophysics research, run your own experiments, and learn how the science is used in society.
who_can_apply: Current high school students in the United States.
pay_detail: Free. The program, room and board are free for all participants.
deadline_text: Applications are open early December through March each year, for the late-July program. The next window is expected December 2026 to March 2027. Exact dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the page linked from the MSU Spartan Youth listing. Contact: Zach Constan, constan@frib.msu.edu or 517-908-7363.
notes: The Spartan Youth program page loaded on 2026-10-10 and confirms the late-July timing, the early December to March application window, the free cost, grades 9 to 12 and the contacts.
